answer: Start by making each identity cost something real to hold. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the violet of free entry disappears, the timber of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the spiral case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm.
